content.stem: 公司内部的货物和服务供应可能因腐败而受到影响,尤其是索贿和收受贿赂、回扣,原因在于:(选择两项.)

options.A: 某些承包商可能会受到优待，使他们在投标过程中有机会抬高利润空间。
options.B: 未中标者将被告知决定，并获提供授予合同的详细理由。
options.C: 采购和合同流程涉及招标过程的管理，而这一过程可能缺乏足够的监督。

content.stem_en: The supply of goods and services can be vulnerable to corruption within a company, particularly the solicitation and receipt of bribes and kickbacks, because: (Choose Two.)

options_en.A: Certain contractors may receive preferential treatment, allowing them opportunities to inflate margins during the tender process.
options_en.B: Unsuccessful bidders are informed of decisions and provided detailed justifications for awarding the contracts.
options_en.C: Procurement and contracting processes involve the management of the tender process, which may lack sufficient oversight.
